records.role: processor hosting the atePDF API; terminates TLS and runs its code
endpoints: same host as atepdf-service (Vercel custom domain)
records.receives: class H + H-09 in transit and function memory

dataRegion.execution: Function pinned to exactly one region, iad1 (US East); Function Failover off and no functionFailoverRegions. Vercel documents Node.js multi-region Function failover as an Enterprise feature that a team must enable; atePDF never enables it (AI-3). An iad1 outage makes the API unavailable (fail closed).
dataRegion.ingress: Requests reach the Vercel point of presence nearest the user, which routes them over Vercel's private network to the nearest Vercel region; that region handles TLS termination (Vercel regions page). The ingress region, and CDN-layer rerouting during a regional outage, can be outside the US, so class H + H-09 transit it in memory before execution in iad1.
dataRegion.logs: UNKNOWN: log storage region not documented
dataRegion.deployedConfiguration: UNKNOWN until deployment: the deployment summary must show one Function region and no failover region (case S80)

retention.payload: UNKNOWN: request-body capture is not documented either way (including at the ingress region)
retention.runtimeLogs: method, path, query string, status, host, user agent, client IP, region, firewall result, function metadata, outgoing sub-requests and all console output; 1 day on Pro with the project excluded from Observability Plus (30 days if Plus applies; Plus is on by default for Pro teams created on or after 2026-04-03); cannot be disabled

records.trainingUse: paid Pro opted out of Vercel AI-training data use by default (March 2026 terms changelog); verify in Team Settings > Data Preferences

retention.promptCache: GPT-5.6 and later: prompt_cache_options.ttl '30m' (only value, default) is the minimum eligibility window; 'OpenAI may retain it longer'; the data-controls page states cached application state (encrypted KV tensors in GPU-local storage) 'is not retained after the 24-hour expiration' and that ttl 'controls the minimum cache lifetime, not this maximum application-state retention period' (documented maximum 24 hours); explicit mode with the breakpoint after atePDF's fixed prefix (tools + developer message) means the user message is not written to the cache
